title: 第105章 饶命？去你的！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 唐敬，刘温等一众大臣听完炎文帝的话，气得脸都紫了。　　这时候，他们才发现被皇帝结结实实地摆了一道！　　皇帝早猜到他们肯定会找小诗仙的麻烦，于是主动通过一些小手段，暴露唐逸就是小诗仙。　　接下来，就交给他们自己求证。　　结果一查，唐逸在唐家地位如狗，连下人都能随意欺凌，是唐家公用的仆从！　　这样的人，怎么可能是小诗仙？怎么可能写得出《满江红》那种慷慨激昂的诗词？　　于是乎……正确答案瞬间就被他们排除在外，朝着错误的方向越走越远。　　可以说，他们从一开始，就一直被炎文帝牵着鼻子走。　　而这其中最强的辅助，莫过于唐敬了。　　众人没有理会炎文帝，看向唐敬的目光却冰冷至极，很想打这货一顿。　　要不是唐敬信誓旦旦地保证唐逸不是小诗仙，他们可能秉持着宁杀错不放过的原则，早就将唐逸给收拾了。　　而唐敬呢？此时看着唐逸，那一双眼睛中满是复杂和愤怒。　　原来这混账没有胡说，他说的都是真的，他真的是小诗仙。　　唐逸在他的面前有几次都主动承认自己是小诗仙了，只是他不相信而已，但凡相信一点，他也不至于现在这般被动。　　现在听到炎文帝说让他们见证唐逸是小诗仙，唐敬心头就直发毛，今日他带唐家过来是来享受掌声的，不是来接受嘲讽的！　　唐逸是小诗仙，那这场宴会，就是唐逸和唐画强强对决。　　唐画赢了还好，要是唐画输了呢？那唐家今日丢人可就丢大了。　　“陛下……”　　唐敬下意识想要阻止，炎文帝已经平静打断他：“唐侍郎生了两个好儿子，都是国之栋梁，朕心甚慰。”　　“今日，朕和群臣便一起考察考察唐爱卿的两位公子，到底谁更胜一筹，”　　说到这里，炎文帝话锋一转：“当然，在见证之前，有点小事还是得处理下。”　　他抱着唐音，嘴角的笑容渐渐收敛。　　目光落在刘州的身上，炎文帝眼神渐渐冷：“刘州是吧？朕看你刚才挺猖狂的，嗓门也贼大，朕给你换个方式叫唤吧！”　　“来人，将他拖下去，杖责三十，再命人将那张桌子砍成碎末，让他给吃了！”　　“他不是说唐逸是小诗仙，他要将桌子吃了吗？朕成全他！”　　“但朕看在刘爱卿的面上，不让他生吃，剁成细末喂给他。”　　今日的沈园诗会，不仅京都勋贵豪族都参加了，还有其他国家的使团也参加了，可以说今日这里的一举一动，都影响着大炎的形象。　　而刘州刚才的所作所为，已经给大炎文坛抹黑，自己将自己国家的形象打得稀巴烂。　　对一个小女孩口出污秽之语，这是君子之国能做出来的事情？　　而且既然是君子之国，那自然得说到做到！　　说吃桌子，那就得吃桌子。　　“陛下，陛下饶命啊！”　　刘州听到炎文帝的话，浑身一颤，双腿间便已经湿了一大片。　　当场被彻底吓得尿失禁了。　　被打三十大板，能不能活下来暂且不说，就身边那张比他还要高大的桌子，剁成碎末喂给他，也能将他当场撑死。　　他不想死啊！　　他是户部尚书的儿子，要风得风要雨得雨，金钱女人随手拈来，岂能甘心这样死了。　　眼看锦衣卫已经上前，刘州瞬间吓得鬼哭狼嚎：“陛下饶命，陛下饶命，我错了，我知错了啊！”　　“爹，爹，救命啊！救我啊！”　　刘温连忙爬了出来，脑袋重重磕在地上：“陛下，臣……”　　“朕知道爱卿教子无方，家教不严，罪不可赦。”　　炎文帝漠漠看了刘温一眼，道：“但朕念你与朝有功，今日便不与你计较，罚俸一年，同时准你休沐一月，回去整顿家风。”　　“户部一切事宜，暂时交由户部主事沈涛负责。”　　刚好要彻查户部，刘温作为户部一把手，权势滔天，对调查会有阻碍。　　那就趁机让他休息一段时间吧！　　休息休息，就彻底休息了。　　毕竟唐逸这小崽子，已经掌控了顾城案的证据，刘温是户部尚书肯定是脱不了干系的。　　而刘温听到炎文帝的话，整个人当时都傻了。　　我是这个意思吗？　　我不是这个意思啊！　　我只是想给我儿子求求情而已，你就让我休沐一个月？　　一个月的时间，我回到户部权力也被架空了好吗！　　“臣……臣遵旨！”刘温叩头谢恩。　　皇帝都这么说了，他还能怎么办？　　难不成众目睽睽之下抗旨不遵吗？　　那会死得更快。　　刘州见到求爹无望，直接扑到唐逸的面前跪了下来。　　“唐逸，我错了，我以后再也不会和你为敌，求你帮我求求情，你帮我求求情啊！”　　“我给你道歉，我给你磕头了，饶了我，饶了我啊……”　　“……”　　唐逸低头看着刘州，此时他满脸惶恐，鼻涕眼泪糊了一脸，狼狈不堪，哪里还有之前的猖狂嘚瑟。　　饶命？　　去你妈的！　　对敌人仁慈，就是对自己残忍！　　他抬脚直接一脚踹了过去，轰的一脚踹在刘州的胸口上，直接将刘州踹飞出去三四米，身体落地又滑行出去好几米才停下来。　　这一脚，唐逸没有半点留情。　　刘州只觉得五脏六腑都像是踹得离了位，刚落地他就直接一口鲜血吐了出来。　　然而，刘州却丝毫不顾疼痛，抹着满嘴鲜血冲着唐逸磕头道：“唐逸，你出了气没，没出气你可以再踹两脚，只要你和陛下求求情，饶了我，饶了我啊……”　　“我是条狗，你就当我是条狗放了。”　　众人见到刘州的狼狈样子，也是有些不屑，刚才你有多狂妄？现在竟然跪在了敌人的面前求饶。　　“饶你？”唐逸目光盯着刘州，冷漠开口。　　“如果今日我不是小诗仙，你会不会饶了我？”　　刘州脸色顿时僵硬。　　肯定不会饶啊！　　他早就给唐逸想了无数种死法了。　　先将他全身骨头打断，再将他丢到街上，让他像条狗一样满地爬，再将他妹妹弄到青楼，供那些有特殊癖好的男人享受……　　只是现在不能承认，承认就得死！　　“会，会，你求饶我就会放了你的，我会……”　　刘州跪在地上，拍着胸膛保证。
content_en: After listening to Emperor Yanwen's words, Tang Jing, Liu Wen and other ministers were so angry that their faces turned purple.At this time, they realized that the emperor had made a solid move!The emperor had already guessed that they would definitely cause trouble for Xiao Shixian, so he took the initiative to expose Tang Yi as Xiao Shixian through some small means.Next, it’s up to them to verify it themselves.As a result of the investigation, Tang Yi's status in the Tang family was like that of a dog. He could even bully the servants at will. He was a public servant of the Tang family!How could such a person be the Little Poet Fairy?How is it possible to write an impassioned poem like "The River is Red"?Ever since...the correct answer was instantly excluded by them, heading further and further in the wrong direction.It can be said that they have been led by Emperor Yanwen from the beginning.The most powerful assistant among them is none other than Tang Jing.Everyone ignored Emperor Yan Wen and looked at Tang Jing with extremely cold eyes, wanting to beat him up.If it weren't for Tang Jing's solemn assurance that Tang Yi was not a little poetry fairy, they might have dealt with Tang Yi long ago, adhering to the principle of preferring to kill the wrong one.And what about Tang Jing?Looking at Tang Yi at this time, his eyes were full of complexity and anger.It turns out that this bastard wasn't talking nonsense. What he said was true. He was really a little poetry fairy.Tang Yi took the initiative to admit that he was a little poetry fairy in front of him several times, but he just didn't believe it. If he believed a little, he wouldn't be so passive now.Now that Tang Jing heard that Emperor Yanwen asked them to prove that Tang Yi was a little poetry fairy, Tang Jing's heart went crazy. He brought the Tang family here today to enjoy the applause, not to accept ridicule!Tang Yi is a little poetry fairy, so this banquet is a showdown between Tang Yi and Tang Hua.It's okay if Tang Hua wins, but what if Tang Hua loses?It would be a big shame for the Tang family to be embarrassed today."Your Majesty..." Tang Jing subconsciously wanted to stop him, but Emperor Yanwen had already calmly interrupted him: "I am very relieved that the Minister of Tang has given birth to two good sons, both of whom are pillars of the country." "Today, I and the ministers will inspect together."Tang Aiqing's two young masters, who is better?" At this point, Emperor Yanwen changed the subject: "Of course, there are some small things that need to be dealt with before witnessing."He hugged Tang Yin, and the smile on his lips gradually faded.Emperor Yanwen's gaze fell on Liu Zhou, and Emperor Yanwen's eyes gradually became cold: "Liu Zhou, right? I saw that you were quite arrogant just now, and your voice was really loud, so I'll give you another way to call him!" "Come here, drag him down, give him thirty punishments, and then order people to chop the table into pieces and let him eat it!" "He didn't say that Tang Yi was a little poetry fairy!"Is he going to eat the table? I will help him!""But for Liu Aiqing's sake, I will not let him eat it raw. I will chop it into fine pieces and feed it to him."Today's Shenyuan Poetry Recital was not only attended by nobles and nobles in Kyoto, but also by delegations from other countries. It can be said that every move here affects Dayan's image.What Liu Zhou did just now has already discredited the literary world of Dayan, and he has beaten his own country's image to pieces.Speaking dirty words to a little girl, is this something that a country of gentlemen can do?And since it is a country of gentlemen, it is natural that we must do what we say!When it comes to eating from the table, you have to eat from the table."Your Majesty, your Majesty, please spare your life!" When Liu Zhou heard Emperor Yanwen's words, he trembled all over, and a large area of ​​water was already wet between his legs.I was so frightened that I became incontinent.Regardless of whether he could survive being beaten thirty times, the table next to him that was taller than him could kill him on the spot if it was chopped into pieces and fed to him.He doesn’t want to die!He was the son of the Minister of the Ministry of Revenue. He had everything he wanted, and he had money and women at his fingertips. How could he be willing to die like this?Seeing that the Jin Yiwei had already stepped forward, Liu Zhou was so frightened that he cried and howled: "Your Majesty, spare your life, Your Majesty, spare your life, I was wrong, I know I was wrong!" "Dad, dad, help me! Save me!" Liu Wen quickly crawled out and banged his head on the ground: "Your Majesty, I..." "I know that I love you for your incompetence in raising your children and your lax upbringing. Your crime is unforgivable."Emperor Yanwen glanced at Liu Wen indifferently and said, "But I think you have made great contributions to the court, so I will not argue with you today. I will fine you a year's salary and allow you to take a month's rest to go back and straighten out your family." "All matters in the Household Department will be temporarily handed over to the head of the Household Department, Shen Tao." A thorough investigation of the Household Department is about to take place. As the head of the Household Department, Liu Wen has great power and will hinder the investigation.Then take the opportunity to let him rest for a while!Rest, rest completely.After all, this little brat Tang Yi has already mastered the evidence of the Gu Cheng case. Liu Wen is the Minister of the Ministry of Revenue, so he must have something to do with it.When Liu Wen heard what Emperor Yanwen said, he was stunned.​Is that what I mean?That’s not what I meant!I just want to beg for mercy for my son. You just want me to take a rest for a month?Within a month, my power was removed when I returned to the Ministry of Household Affairs, okay?"I...I obey your order!" Liu Wen kowtowed and thanked him.The emperor has said so, what else can he do?Is it possible to resist and disobey orders in full view of the public?That will make you die faster.Seeing that there was no hope of begging for his father, Liu Zhou threw himself directly in front of Tang Yi and knelt down."Tang Yi, I was wrong, I will never be your enemy again, please help me beg for mercy, please help me beg for mercy!" "I apologize to you, I kowtow to you, spare me, spare me..." "..." Tang Yi lowered his head and looked at Liu Zhou. At this time, his face was full of fear, his face was covered with snot and tears, and he was in a state of embarrassment. There was no trace of the rampant rant before.Spare your life?Go to hell!To be kind to your enemies is to be cruel to yourself!He raised his foot and kicked Liu Zhou hard on the chest, sending Liu Zhou flying three to four meters. His body landed on the ground and slid for several meters before stopping.Tang Yi showed no mercy in this kick.Liu Zhou felt as if his internal organs had been kicked out of place. As soon as he landed on the ground, he spit out a mouthful of blood.However, Liu Zhou ignored the pain at all, wiped his mouth full of blood and kowtowed to Tang Yi: "Tang Yi, have you vented your anger? If you haven't vented your anger, you can kick me again. As long as you beg His Majesty, spare me, spare me..." "I am a dog, just treat me like a dog and let me go."
